areas.title: Merge and GitHub side: a project never writes into or lists another project's status pull request, a person's commit in a task's folder is never dropped, a chain with a busy middle is rebuilt without a false conflict, one card per conflict, Merge says at once why it waits, 'I resolved it' starts the work, conflict notices within one poll, no ids in GitHub text, and every merge sentence and Tasks label agrees with its buttons and the Overview

decisions: W15-01 (only the safety part, until the owner answers W15-112): an ownership marker in the status and scaffold PR bodies; a project never pushes to, comments on or lists another project's status or scaffold PR; while another project's status PR is open on fr/status this project writes none and its status stays in the app (one log line says why); with none open, today's behaviour; a legacy PR without a marker belongs to a project only when it is the only one on this install linked to the repository. No per-project branch and no second PR.

W15-02: a local commit ahead of origin on a done task's branch that is not Forerunner's own (its work-in-progress commit, its base merge, a rebuild whose push failed) holds the rebuild with one sentence and is never reset; Forerunner's own unpushed states rebuild as today.

W15-03: a dependency whose rebuild was busy, held, failed or conflicted holds the tasks that build on it as owed in the same pass; a clean same-own-change rebuild clears a stale rebuild_conflict (sentence, last_outcome and card).

W15-04: the Tasks tab's Redo on a done task with an open merge card answers that card as the card's own Redo does (redo from main, the card closed 'redone') in the same transaction, and starts no session: the owner question on Tasks-row actions stays open.

W15-05: the person's approval stays recorded and the merge goes on once the folder is clean; the held-by-changes fact is persisted on the record at the poll and shown on the row before and after the press.

W15-06: both 'I resolved it' and 'Drop the branch and retry from scratch' start or queue a session through resumeWork, as every Inbox answer that makes a task runnable does (design §3.8); Cancel starts nothing.
W15-07: a null mergeable is re-read within the same poll (a few seconds apart, capped at about 15 s in all), never by a busy loop.
W15-08: ids that code reads move to a hidden HTML-comment marker (one form shared with W15-01's ownership marker); the reader accepts the old visible form for PRs opened by earlier versions.

W15-55: one label per merge record outcome in task-words.ts's merge-state branch (now w15-merge's), agreeing with the Overview row (design §2: one status map), including the states W15-03 and W15-05 add.

W15-64: emptiedSentence's two failing forms, 'main already has this change.' and the up_to_date PR comment are reworded to the texts in the acceptance; owedFolderSentence was checked against design §5 and stays (W15-05's tests can assert it).
W15-68: the waiting_checks sentence and label are chosen by the outcome's status ('#4 merges once GitHub answers.' for an unreachable host).
root_causes: packages/runtime/src/loop/docs.ts: the status branch and PR belong to the repository, not to a project (fixed name, PR reused by head only, ownership approved for any fr/status PR, no marker).

packages/capabilities/src/githost/pr-executor.ts rebuildDependents/rebuildIn: a busy middle does not hold its dependents; a local commit is reset to origin; only uncommitted changes count as the person's.

packages/runtime/src/session/dependent-branches.ts and loop/merge.ts: conflict state is cleared only from last_outcome 'conflict'; a new review or a clean rebuild leaves stale cards; the watcher reads mergeable once per 60 s poll and drops null.

packages/runtime/src/daemon/pull-requests.ts / loop/merge-mode.ts: the merge route answers from canMerge before the folder state is known, and the record never carries that state until the merge step runs.
packages/runtime/src/session/pr-answers.ts: only the rebuild card's Redo resumes work; the rebase-conflict card has no words of its own.
packages/capabilities/src/githost/git.ts: parsed git messages assume English where untranslated is not set; folders made before 29e0c81 keep the machine's autocrlf.

packages/runtime/src/daemon/task-words.ts's merge-state branch and the merge-side sentences (merge.ts, pr-executor.ts emptiedSentence, pull-requests.ts rows): labels and sentences read a subset of the merge record (any last_outcome but 'conflict' reads 'waiting for you to merge'; the waiting_checks sentence whatever the status) and offer ways out no button gives.
